title: Men backed Democrats in the midterms. Will they stick with them next time?
description: Democrats won after appealing to male voters. Now they have to figure out how to keep them.

title: Justice Department braces for congressional scrutiny after Democrats sweep elections
description: Democrats have pledged to probe the Justice Department’s actions during Trump’s second term. He has ordered the agency to investigate Democrats.

title: Why both parties may benefit from wide-open, hard-fought 2028 primaries
description: Members of the Democratic and Republican parties say the country and political system are better off when candidates and their ideas are tested.

title: In the Mississippi Delta, a fight to make every vote count
description: How a group of young Black women helped Democrat Scott Colom do the unthinkable, potentially flipping a deep-red Senate seat.

title: Potential Vance challengers smell blood in the water after brutal GOP losses
description: The vice president has not made up his mind on running for president in 2028. His potential rivals, however, are wasting little time to prepare.

title: NPR's Moscow and Beijing correspondents discuss the reaction to U.S. elections abroad
description: The results of the U.S. midterms were closely followed overseas. NPR correspondents in Moscow and Beijing discuss how the elections are seen in the countries they cover.

title: Republican consultant discusses what went wrong and what's next for the GOP
description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe speaks to Hogan Gidley, a Republican consultant and former White House Deputy Press Secretary during the first Trump administration, about the GOP's post-midterm strategy.

title: Historically red state legislatures have flipped. Here's what's on their agenda
description: Democrats made sweeping gains in state legislatures across the country. We look at North Carolina and Arizona to see what that could mean.

title: Week in politics: Democrats plan for the next Congress, Trump's new Chief of Staff
description:
Democrats plans for the next Congress, where they'll hold significant majorities in both chambers.
Meanwhile, President Trump signals his plans by promoting Stephen Miller as his new Chief of Staff.

title: How Gen Z voters helped fuel a blue wave for Democrats
description: Republicans made gains with young voters in 2024, but in this year's midterms Americans under 30 issued a strong rebuke of President Trump and his party, voting decisively for Democrats instead.

title: UFC's Dana White says he will meet with Trump Monday over offer to be White House press secretary
description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has offered the job of White House press secretary to his friend and UFC boss Dana White.

title: Stephen Miller’s promotion sets the stage for a new era of confrontation
description: With Democrats poised to regain control of Congress, President Donald Trump’s elevation of Miller to replace Susie Wiles signals an emphasis on ideological combat over compromise.

title: Trump says he offered White House press secretary role to UFC’s Dana White
description: The UFC chief executive and longtime Trump political supporter declined to discuss the offer but said he plans to meet with the president on Monday.

title: Former Maryland Gov. Hogan calls midterms ‘complete and total rebuke of Trump’
description: On CNN, Republican Larry Hogan criticized the White House for doubling down on unpopular approaches while ignoring political independents.

title: Republican Sen. Ron Johnson accuses Trump administration of corruption
description: On Joe Rogan's podcast, the senator from Wisconsin cited claims by a former White House adviser and accused Trump aides of catering to special interests.

title: Judge taps ex-prosecutor to probe lawyer conduct in Trump golf course fight
description: A former U.S. attorney for D.C. will look into whether Trump administration lawyers committed ethical violations in the battle over East Potomac Golf Links.

title: Sen. Van Hollen says Schumer should not get ‘blank check’ to be majority leader
description: The senator from Maryland says Democrats need to have a discussion and receive commitments before choosing a leader.

title: Here are the midterm races to watch that are still too close to call
description: There are 19 House races and two Senate races that are yet to be called.

title: Susie Wiles’s exit adds to list of women leaving top roles in Trump administration
description: Trump named Stephen Miller to replace Wiles as chief of staff. Pam Bondi and Kristi Noem are among other high-ranking women who have left.

title: Trump calls for Justice Department to investigate Democrats
description: Democrats have pledged sweeping investigations of Trump's second administration.

title: Two House Republicans battle to lead the party’s diminished ranks
description: The race for House minority leader is a rematch between two longtime rivals: House Majority Leader Steve Scalise and Judiciary Committee Chair Jim Jordan.

title: Texas's 'Blue Tsunami' has former Texas congressman Beto O'Rourke 'over the moon'
description: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with former Texas congressman Beto O'Rourke about how past efforts by him and other Democrats helped the party win big in Texas in the midterms.

title: President of The Heritage Foundation looks ahead to the future of the GOP
description: Kevin Roberts, the president of the conservative think tank The Heritage Foundation, talks about the organization's priorities and hopes for the future of the Republican Party and its policies.

title: 3 things to know about Stephen Miller, new White House chief of staff
description: Here’s three things to know about President Donald Trump’s new chief of staff.

title: Hispanic voters were key in powering Democratic midterm wins
description: All 10 of the U.S. counties with the biggest swings toward Democrats in the midterm elections had majority-Hispanic populations.

title: Florida’s most Venezuelan city put the Republican Party on notice
description: A city in South Florida where many residents fled a socialist strongman voted for a democratic socialist Senate candidate.

title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday. The Senate voted on his impeachment after the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.

title: Houston, we have a wardrobe problem
description: NASA’s race against China to return to the moon depends on Axiom Space, a start-up with an uneven record and a Prada partnership. Its investors include a firm where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner.

title: Historic voter turnout powered Democrats’ blue wave
description: Voter turnout reached its second-highest peak in more than a century, driving surprise victories for Democrats.

title: A reckoning pushes out six congressmen accused of sexual misconduct, domestic abuse
description: Recent months have shown the most effective tool for accountability may be public opinion.

title: How the new Senate majority shifts control over the federal judiciary
description: The change in the Senate's majority party means that starting Jan. 3, Democrats will run federal judicial appointments and may continue to until at least 2030.

title: Hegseth draws fire after using government resources for partisan video
description: Watchdog groups said the defense secretary’s self-promotional messaging as he fights to keep his job probably violated federal law.

title: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis planning another White House run
description: Florida’s status as one of the few red states to mostly withstand the Democratic sweep will be a core part of his argument, an adviser says.

title: Stephen Miller is named new White House chief of staff as Susie Wiles departs
description: The staffing shake-up comes as Trump remains angry over Tuesday’s midterm losses, and it means his policy agenda will probably move further to the right.

title: First openly gay sheriff in Alabama is Navy SEAL who vows to cut ties with Flock
description: Voters also chose Allison Montgomery as the first openly transgender person elected to the state legislature.

title: Florida approved a controversial property tax measure. What comes next?
description: Local leaders and first responders who opposed the amendment warned it could lead to painful cuts in services.

title: Sen. Murphy discharged from hospital after stroke, will miss weeks of votes
description: A doctor said the Connecticut Democrat has made “tremendous progress” and is expected to make a full recovery after rehabilitation.

title: Republicans in North Carolina lose 4 more House seats as GOP wipeout spreads
description: In North Carolina, Republican Reps. Addison McDowell, Brad Knott, Richard Hudson and Tim Moore all lost. Reps. Greg Murphy, Virginia Foxx and David Rouzer may be next.

title: Trump ally declines to back Hegseth when asked whether he should be replaced
description: Rep. James Comer told News Nation that there are “a lot of questions” about the defense secretary after the GOP’s midterm rout and that “no one’s happy about Iran.”

title: Two more DOJ officials resign, including head of national security division
description: Jason Reding Quiñones and John Eisenberg are the latest high-profile officials to depart the Justice Department following Tuesday’s midterms rout.

title: Trump endorses embattled RNC chairman after GOP shellacking
description: Joe Gruters “will do an incredible job in 2028,” the president wrote on Truth Social.

title: Schumer poised to lead Senate again after surviving Democratic backlash
description: Less than two years ago, the New York Democrat faced a deluge of criticism from the party’s base. His party won back the Senate decisively in Tuesday’s midterms.

title: Democrat Scott Wiener wins race for Nancy Pelosi’s seat in California
description: Wiener defeated Democrat Connie Chan, a San Francisco supervisor. He will step into the seat held by former House speaker Nancy Pelosi, who endorsed Chan.

title: How Islamophobia backfired and helped elect the first Muslim senator
description: Islamophobic rhetoric against Democrat Abdul El-Sayed backfired on Republicans in a state with one of the country’s largest Arab and Muslim populations.

title: Americans voted on the economy. Here’s what’s changed since Trump took office.
description: Inflation is outpacing wages, but the labor market remains resilient.

title: A history-making Black governor can’t believe Mississippi’s Senate election
description: L. Douglas Wilder, the first African American elected governor of any state since Reconstruction, is shocked to see Mississippi on the verge of electing a Black senator.
